fusions.name: Wrong-Hand Release
fusions.desc: Throws from the hand the target isn't watching, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Grin at the Finish
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank, and has 30% more critical chance against an unwounded foe.

fusions.name: Feint, Then Mean It
fusions.desc: Steps you 2 tiles from where you stood and clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Opening Made
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your physical damage rises by 20% for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
